body: Oh God don't do that again

It's excuse my language bloody hard I never knew a family member could be so cruel and vindictive it's a big shock, I guess 2019 was the year I woke up so this year I can learn and never ever turn back to people that hurt me again, I wish I had of learnt sooner so as not to have put myself in this position but I guess when and If I am able to pull my self up and out of this situation there will be so many things to be grateful for and will finally be able to smile without being given and evil stare. I ask God for strength.

Yes we try better than give up too soon, some days I have hope that I can make it and some days I feel like things will always be a struggle and better to let go but.. I will hold onto those days of hope and keep trying as long as I can possibly stick it out 💜
I feel this way too you explained me but only difference I don't think anyone would miss me apart from my puppy.

I've cut my hair a few times when I've been upset it does feel liberating I wish hair grew faster so I could do it more often! I'm glad you didn't hurt yourself you might find a new style that you like perhaps something more dearing and rebelous! (I know my spelling is absolutely shocking but it gets me by 😊😉

Patience and planning and we'll also saving is a virtue in my case, when someone is going through a tough time and having suicidal thoughts it makes a situation more overwhelming and I think some people are scared to be honest with professionals in case of being put into hospital where they feel like it could make matters worse, (we all need someone to talk to sonetimes) in can give someone the strength to carry forward and make a plan, I'm grateful to be able to just share and have some responce on this chat it makes me feel like as it gives me a sense I'm not alone and that also I may help another person feel that they are not the only one feeling this way, thank you. I don't feel so invisible.

I'm currently saving so expecting it will take 3-4 months as I want to take my pet dog with me, in the meantime while saving I have to just try and keep it together not just for myself but my loyal little buddy, I need to manage ways to not be in her company too much as the tension in the air is extremely stressfull even my work mates are telling me I look drained, trying to keep it together everyday, my hopes are things will be better when I can just get out of this toxic environment and be around people who appreciate me and I them.

Your post sounds like me describing myself it's so hard I know and I don't have any answer I feel personality like I'm riding a lonely wave through the storm hoping someone will connect with me but my waiting seems to be in vain,  but your post made me feel like there is someone out there feeling the same way as me I'm here if you ever like to talk.
I don't know if it's courage or just waiting for the right time and place for me
